findings.message: Declaring an optional parameter before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.0. Parameter $content is optional, while parameter $render_slug is required. The $content parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.

Declaring an optional parameter before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.0. Parameter $content is optional, while parameter $render_slug is required. The $content parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.
Implicitly marking a parameter as nullable is deprecated since PHP 8.4. Update the type to be explicitly nullable instead. Found implicitly nullable parameter: $slider_title.
